title: Data Center Construction Manager
description: About the Company Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada’s solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense. With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI - rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud. Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You’ll tackle challenges that haven’t been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada’s mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world. About the role The Data Center Construction Manager will serve as Armada's on-site lead during the installation, startup, and commissioning phases of the Leviathan data center, driving the facility to Ready for Service (RFS). This role bridges traditional construction site management with data center startup and commissioning expertise, acting as the primary point of coordination between the customer's General Contractor (GC) and subcontracted trades, Armada's own subcontractors and trades, and the Commissioning Authority (CxA) team. The ideal candidate combines a strong construction management background with hands-on experience bringing mission-critical or industrial facilities from substantial completion through commissioning to RFS. Location This is an on-site, field-based role located at the Leviathan data center project site [Australia] for the duration of installation, startup, and commissioning. Must be able to walk active construction sites, climb ladders/stairs, and work in mechanical/electrical spaces under construction; PPE required at all times. Schedule may require extended hours, weekend work, and short-notice availability during critical energization and testing windows to support RFS milestones. Travel requirements: [20-30%] What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities) Site Coordination & Construction Management Serve as Armada's primary on-site point of contact, coordinating daily activities across the customer's GC, GC-managed subcontractors, and Armada's own subcontracted trades. Develop, maintain, and enforce integrated site logistics plans, look-ahead schedules, and work sequencing across multiple concurrent trade crews. Chair or participate in daily and weekly coordination meetings (OAC meetings, trade stacking, site safety huddles) to align GC, subcontractor, and commissioning schedules. Identify and resolve field conflicts — space, sequencing, access, utility tie-ins — before they impact schedule. Track and drive closure of punch lists, RFIs, and deficiency logs tied to startup readiness. Maintain daily site reports, photo documentation, and progress logs for internal and customer stakeholders. Commissioning Coordination (Path to RFS) Serve as the field liaison to the Commissioning Authority (CxA), ensuring construction completion aligns with the Level 1–5 commissioning sequence. Coordinate system turnover packages, startup sequencing, and system-by-system readiness with mechanical, electrical, controls, and fire/life safety trades. Support and track execution of pre-functional checklists, functional performance testing (FPT), and integrated systems testing (IST). Escalate and manage resolution of commissioning-driven punch items, ensuring trades remobilize quickly to close gaps. Partner with the CxA, engineers of record, and OEM startup technicians to sequence equipment energization, startup, and testing safely and efficiently. Maintain visibility into the master commissioning schedule and proactively flag risks to the RFS date. Safety, Quality & Compliance Enforce site safety programs across all trades on site, including GC-managed and Armada-managed crews, in line with customer and jurisdictional requirements. Ensure work is executed per approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards; support QA/QC inspections and documentation. Support permitting, inspection, and AHJ (Authority Having Jurisdiction) coordination as needed to support system energization and occupancy. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Communication Act as a trusted, credible technical and field voice across customer GC leadership, subcontractor superintendents, CxA teams, and Armada leadership. Provide regular progress updates, schedule risk assessments, and RFS readiness reporting to Armada project leadership and the customer. Support change management, ensuring field changes are documented and routed through proper approval channels. Required Qualifications 8+ years of construction site management experience, including 3+ years focused on mission-critical, data center, or industrial startup/commissioning environments. Proven track record coordinating multi-trade, multi-stakeholder job sites through substantial completion, startup, and commissioning to occupancy or RFS. Working knowledge of data center MEP systems (electrical distribution/switchgear, UPS, generators, cooling plants/CRAH-CRAC, BMS/EPMS controls) sufficient to coordinate startup sequencing with the CxA and trades. Familiarity with commissioning process frameworks (e.g., ASHRAE Guideline 0/1.1, Level 1–5 commissioning) and the ability to translate commissioning requirements into field execution plans. Strong scheduling acumen (Primavera P6, MS Project, or similar) and experience managing look-ahead schedules across GC and subcontractor crews. Demonstrated ability to manage relationships with general contractors, subcontractors, and third-party commissioning agents simultaneously. OSHA 30 certification (or willingness to obtain); strong site safety leadership background. Excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable presenting schedule and risk status to customer and executive stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience with hyperscale or colocation data center construction/startup programs. Working knowledge of building automation/controls systems and integrated systems testing (IST) processes. Existing relationships with major data center GCs, CxA firms, and MEP trade contractors. PMP, CxA, or CCM certification. Experience owning or supporting RFS/turnover documentation packages (O&M manuals, as-builts, warranty documentation). #LI-AB1 #861 #LI-Remote You're a Great Fit if You're A go-getter with a growth mindset. title: iOS Developer
description: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app. This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers. What Will You Build Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys. Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile. Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release. Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability. Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch. Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability. What We're Looking For Strong native iOS experience using Swift. Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users. Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns. Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens. Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality. Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar. The Bar We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. This Role Is Not For Engineers who only want fully defined tickets. Developers who build screens without caring about user experience. People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance. Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment. People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany . We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany . Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Digital Account Manager - Netherlands
description: We are the platform turning browsing into shopping . We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases. In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia. Ready to spark your growth with us? WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄 We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members! We are looking for a Digital Account Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise , outstanding client communication , and an AI-first mindset . This is a highly client-facing role : you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey. You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations. The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively , turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI , to work smarter, faster and with better insights. Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships. WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄 Client Communication & Relationship Management Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations Build trusted, long-term relationships and translate client objectives into effective, measurable campaign strategies Campaign Set-up & Coordination Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time Optimization & Performance Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams Reports, Presentations & Sales Support Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals AI-Powered Ways of Working Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation Collaboration & Administration Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration Handle client invoicing WHAT YOU WILL NEED 🪄 Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment. Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships. AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter. Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once. Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions. Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must. Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance. Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English. Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving. 👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you! NICE TO HAVE 🎆 Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion). LOCATION 🌐 While you need to be based in the Netherlands , you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective. WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗 🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company 🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment 🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work 📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions 🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups 🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks 💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are 🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices WHO WE ARE 💜 We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us. TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯 Progress Over Perfection : We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results. Clarity Through Transparency : We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better. Learn Loudly : We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition. Challenge with Empathy : We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust. Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset. description: <p>Build and own a self-service, multi-tenant platform that keeps the critical data of 20+ customers recoverable<br><br>Do you like building platforms that other teams consume, at scale, across private and public clouds, with security and tenant isolation as non-negotiables? title: Control & Estimation Intern
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on. These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation. Your mission The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions. Responsibilities Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment. Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines. Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware. Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions. Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment. Candidates Requirements Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus. Technical skills : Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus. Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. title: IT Security Analyst
description: Company Overview Kairos Power is a new nuclear energy technology and engineering company whose mission is to enable the world’s transition to clean energy, with the ultimate goal to dramatically improve people’s quality of life while protecting the environment. This goal will be accomplished through the commercialization of the fluoride-salt-cooled, high-temperature reactor (FHR) that can be deployed with robust safety, affordable costs, and flexible operation to accommodate the expansion of variable renewables. Job Summary We are searching for an IT Security Analyst II to support and strengthen the security, monitoring, and compliance of our multi-site, hybrid corporate IT infrastructure, on-premises systems, and SaaS application platforms. This role will independently perform security monitoring, vulnerability management, incident response, policy and control administration, and compliance activities within established cybersecurity programs and procedures. The role will collaborate with IT infrastructure, application owners, business teams, and external service providers to identify, assess, and remediate cybersecurity risks. The ideal candidate will have hands-on cybersecurity operations experience in a medium- or enterprise-scale environment, preferably within a highly regulated industry or an organization subject to NIST 800-171, CMMC, or similar security frameworks. Responsibilities Independently monitor and analyze activity across computer networks, systems, cloud platforms, and SaaS applications for suspicious activity and potential security incidents. Configure and onboard supported IT systems and appliances into the enterprise SIEM, including validating log collection and supporting detection and investigation capabilities. Analyze, investigate, and respond to SIEM, endpoint protection, firewall, identity, and access management alerts, escalating complex or high-risk events as appropriate. Investigate and document routine and moderately complex security incidents; coordinate containment and remediation activities and escalate as appropriate. Perform vulnerability management activities, including scanning, analysis, prioritization, reporting, and remediation tracking through closure. Work with IT infrastructure teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and resolve network, endpoint, cloud, and application security risks. Apply and support the maintenance and enforcement of internal IT security policies and procedures, including data handling, acceptable use, access control, and incident response. Perform assigned audit, compliance review, evidence collection, and control assessment activities against applicable regulatory frameworks. Administer and monitor assigned security controls for firewalls, endpoint protection, encryption, identity and access management, multi-factor authentication, and secure remote access. Review user access, permissions, and privileged accounts to enforce least-privilege and zero-trust principles. Support security awareness initiatives and reinforce cybersecurity best practices across the organization. Maintain accurate documentation of security incidents, risks, procedures, control evidence, and remediation activities. Coordinate assigned security activities with third-party cybersecurity vendors and managed service providers. title: Product Designer
description: Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide. Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Check out our Forbes Fintech 50 and CNBC and Statista's World's Top Fintech Companies 2026 ! We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you will shape direction, explore ideas through prototypes, and carry the details through launch and iteration. Your work will help people discover opportunities, make informed decisions, and trade with confidence. Responsibilities Lead end-to-end product design, from understanding user needs and framing the problem to prototyping, implementation, launch, and improvement. Partner with PMs and engineers to define priorities, shape product direction, and connect design decisions to meaningful user and business outcomes. Design coherent mobile and desktop flows that make complex concepts, transaction states, costs, risks, and next actions easy to understand. Explore alternatives with realistic prototypes and use research, analytics, critique, and dogfooding to improve the experience. Bring strong visual and interaction craft to complete experiences, including loading, empty, error, recovery, and success states. Work closely with Engineering to preserve quality in the shipped product and follow through on feedback after release. Reuse and improve shared components and patterns, helping Phantom feel consistent across product areas. Communicate decisions, dependencies, and capacity risks early, and contribute constructively to team critique and learning. Qualifications A portfolio of shipped consumer products showing ownership of substantial, complex journeys and clear personal contribution. Strong product thinking and the ability to turn ambiguous problems into coherent experiences and practical delivery plans. Excellent visual and interaction design skills across mobile and desktop, with proficiency in layout, typography, hierarchy, and reusable systems. Experience using realistic prototypes to communicate behavior and test important assumptions. A record of effective partnership with Product and Engineering, including constructive disagreement and follow-through on implementation quality. Clear communication of design rationale, tradeoffs, outcomes, and lessons learned. Ability to use user feedback and product evidence to make decisions and improve work after launch. Curiosity about crypto and financial products, with the ability to learn complex domains quickly. Prior crypto employment is welcome but is not required. Why Work With Us Phantom's journey to becoming a global trading app began with making crypto easier to use. Today, we’re building on that foundation to help people discover the markets that matter, make informed financial moves, and safely store or spend their money worldwide. Joining Phantom means helping shape that next chapter: building products that bring the freedom of open markets to more people. Build for global impact: Create products used by tens of millions of people, making innovative financial markets more accessible to users around the world. Make complexity feel simple: Solve meaningful challenges across design, engineering, and user experience to make discovering markets and managing money seamless. Put users in control: Help build a future where people have greater freedom over their assets and financial decisions, with security and self-custody at the foundation. title: Senior Product Manager (Prediction Markets)

Make trading simpler for someone placing a first prediction and more powerful for someone placing their fiftieth of the day. Build a team that stays close to traders. Talk to them every week, read support tickets, and dogfood every build. Turn what you learn into roadmap decisions, and make these habits part of how the team works. Make every trade trustworthy. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. title: Enablement Lead, Government

You will help organizations understand not only what OpenAI’s products can do, but how to apply them safely and effectively while respecting their missions, operating environments, workforce needs, and responsibilities to the public. Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence, increasing product adoption, supporting successful launches and deployments, and helping government organizations translate product capabilities into tangible mission outcomes. You will own outcomes related to activation and sustained usage while helping shape how OpenAI enables and supports public-sector customers at scale. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required. In this role, you will: Own the enablement of OpenAI products, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Agents, helping define effective patterns for responsible adoption across government organizations. Lead government customers through the full enablement lifecycle, from initial onboarding and activation through expansion, optimization, and long-term adoption. Define and manage structured enablement and deployment programs with clear goals, milestones, owners, and measures of success. Design and deliver high-impact engagements—including onboarding sessions, advanced capability training, executive briefings, academies, hackathons, listening sessions, and hands-on mission or workflow labs—for audiences ranging from senior leaders to front-line staff. Guide government leaders, champions, technical teams, and working teams through organizational change by building confidence, establishing effective habits, and translating product capabilities into practical workflows and mission outcomes. Serve as a subject matter expert for designated products, roles, or government mission areas, building deep expertise and identifying emerging public-sector use cases for new product capabilities. Develop government-specific learning journeys, training materials, playbooks, FAQs, demonstrations, use cases, customer impact stories, and communications that enable high-quality adoption programs to scale. Provide timely education for product launches, new features, and capability rollouts, translating product updates into clear and practical relevance for government users. Advise government customers on workforce communications and engagement strategies that build awareness, confidence, participation, and sustained use. Build trusted relationships with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, champions, and front-line public servants, creating experiences that reflect an understanding of their constraints, motivations, and responsibilities to the public. Support government customer communities, events, and peer-learning experiences by keeping resources, discussions, updates, and thought leadership useful and current. Identify and amplify government champions, creative use cases, and meaningful customer outcomes that encourage responsible experimentation, recognize public servants’ contributions, and help other organizations learn. Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Product, Global Affairs, Communications, Marketing, Readiness, and other teams to deliver cohesive experiences for public-sector customers. Gather and synthesize government customer feedback, adoption signals, participation data, and engagement outcomes to improve enablement programs and bring the voice of public servants back to Product and other internal stakeholders. Identify patterns across government customers and translate them into scalable programs, content, playbooks, and best practices without losing the human connection required to support public servants effectively. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 6+ years of experience in customer-facing, enablement, instructional, adoption, or transformation roles, engaging executive, business, and technical audiences in government or similarly complex enterprise environments. Understand and value public service and can build credibility with government leaders, program owners, technical teams, and front-line public servants. Possess exceptional presentation, facilitation, and communication skills, particularly when translating complex AI capabilities into clear, accurate, and practical value for audiences with different levels of technical fluency. Have experience designing learning journeys and leading workshops, training programs, executive engagements, customer events, or scaled adoption initiatives. Bring strong practical fluency and enthusiasm across ChatGPT, Agents, and the broader OpenAI product ecosystem, with an understanding of how AI can be applied to real-world government workflows. Are a versatile writer and storyteller who can turn complex information into useful and compelling training materials, presentations, demonstrations, communications, and customer stories. Can connect product capabilities and enablement activities to measurable outcomes such as activation, sustained usage, improved quality, faster delivery, reduced administrative burden, better decision-making, risk reduction, customer satisfaction, or mission impact. Can identify patterns across government customers and convert them into scalable systems, programs, content, and best practices. Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple workstreams, adapting in live customer environments, and bringing clarity and momentum to ambiguous situations. Bring humility, empathy, curiosity, and a genuine desire to help public servants and colleagues succeed. Are personally committed to fostering the safe and responsible evolution of AI. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. title: People Operations Associate (AI and Automation)
description: Hi, I’m Ellie, People Lead at hx. I joined hx in January 2025 as a Senior People Partner and have recently stepped into the People Lead role. Outside of work, I’m an F1 fan and dog mum, so I’m no stranger to fast-paced environments or the occasional pit stop for walkies. Our People team supports all things people at hx, from performance and engagement to the systems, insights and day-to-day operations that help our teams do their best work. We’re growing the team and looking for someone to own our People reporting and analytics, while helping keep the operational side of the function running smoothly. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys turning data into meaningful insights, wants to make a real impact and is excited to help shape how the People team grows alongside the business. Interested? Read more about the role and life at hx below. About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the People team Our People team owns the systems and data that keep hx a high-performance, high-engagement place to work: performance and growth, people analytics, compensation and benefits, and HR compliance. We are building the reporting layer that lets the business make faster, better-evidenced decisions about its people rather than relying on instinct, and we work closely with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data with performance and engagement data so leaders see the full employee lifecycle instead of fragments of it. Inside People and Talent, AI has already changed how we screen, how we write up interviews and how we surface insight to leaders. There is far more to do. Plenty of what we do still runs on manual effort that could be designed out, and this role exists to go after that. We care much more about what you have built and put in front of real users than about the size of the team you have sat in, and impact here isn't tied to title or tenure. You will work directly with People Leaders, with real scope to shape how the team works as we grow. One thing worth being direct about: there is no finished playbook here. If you need a well-defined remit and clear instruction to do your best work, this will be frustrating. If you would rather find the problem yourself and build the fix, you will have a lot of room.. What you'll be doing Build the AI tooling that our People and Talent function runs on. Agents that answer the questions currently landing in our inbox, skills that draft the documents we write manually, workflows that pull our systems together. This is the core of the role rather than a project on the side. Build out the People reporting layer, including dashboards on retention, attrition and engagement, and get to the point where you can tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are. Work with Talent to connect hiring and pipeline data to People data, and make that view something leaders can interrogate themselves. Learn our people processes properly, starting with onboarding, payroll data integrity and the performance cycle, then rebuild the parts that depend on manual effort. Support our performance review cycles in Lattice and our engagement surveys, help analyse what comes out of them, and automate the parts that should not need a person. Help keep our HRIS data accurate, including records, reporting and system troubleshooting. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped something with AI that other people used, whether that is an agent, a script, a tool, a bot or a side project. Got past the first version. We will ask how you tested it, what it got wrong with real users and what you changed as a result. If you have a long list of things you have experimented with, we want to hear what each one taught you. Worked with more than one model or platform, and formed a view on what each is good for. Worked with a real dataset, cleaned it up, and drawn a conclusion you could defend. Been responsible for keeping a system or record accurate, whether that is a tracker, a membership list, a codebase or admin for a part-time role. Handled something that needed to stay confidential, or can show us how you think about handling sensitive information. Genuine interest in how organisations work, and the willingness to learn a domain where the detail matters and the consequences of getting it wrong land on real colleagues. How we build in an AI-forward company hx is a maximally AI-forward company because we believe AI should amplify what exceptional people can achieve. Everyone here is a builder. That means staying close to what’s changing, continuing to learn, and using AI to raise the quality, pace and ambition of your work. We expect everyone to actively experiment with AI and agentic systems, whether at work or in their personal lives. This means going beyond prompting, exploring what agents can do autonomously, and learning by doing. You don't need to be an engineer, but you do need to be curious, hands-on and willing to push what's possible. Your current environment is context, not the answer. We’re interested in how you think about what should be possible now, not simply how things are done where you work today. We care about judgement, creativity and ownership, not simply using more tools. The bar is simple: your work should be meaningfully better because of how you operate in this new world. Compensation This role sits within a £40,000 - £55,000 salary range. At hx, we're committed to salary transparency, you'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, and our Talent Partner will share more detail with you during initial conversations. We're also working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and games nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Skills assessment, presenting a People Analytics deliverable to the team. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. This position analyses, troubleshoots, and communicates maintenance problems and concerns in the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air and process gases, HVAC, and clean utilities, as they relate to equipment and controlled environments in the pharmacy. The Senior Maintenance Manager works with general supervision and interacts regularly with the Director of Maintenance and Reliability to receive guidance and feedback. Many non-routine activities will require the Director’s advance approval. This position will be in Enfield. You Will: Lead a team of maintenance technicians, supervisors, and managers across a multi-shift, multi-discipline operation. Own the predictive and preventive maintenance programme for all GMP equipment, including automated compounding and filling equipment, isolators and cleanroom pharmaceutical safety cabinets (PSCs), laminar airflow (LAF) units, autoclaves and depyrogenation ovens, pharmaceutical fridges, freezers, and cold storage, balances, and associated controls. Maintain and reliably operate facility and clean utilities, including HVAC and cleanroom environmental systems, purified water, compressed air, nitrogen and other process gases, and chilled and hot water systems. Document maintenance, technical, and other data on predictive and preventive maintenance charts, as required. Diagnose and repair equipment and systems throughout the facility, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, compressed air, PLC/controls, and HVAC repairs. Identify facility and equipment issues and develop an ongoing strategy to chart trends and take remedial action using a predictive maintenance approach. Communicate to management all issues that could result in safety risks, product quality impact, or loss to Hims & Hers or its colleagues. Work as directed in all areas of the facility to maintain health and safety standards, ensuring compliance with the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974, PUWER, LOLER, the Pressure Systems Safety Regulations, and COSHH. Perform and oversee calibration and testing procedures on equipment to ensure accurate operation and compliance with quality standards. Conduct regular checks and measurements to verify equipment performance, including temperature, pressure, differential pressure, airflow, and other relevant parameters. Maintain calibration records and documentation in compliance with GMP, MHRA, and GPhC requirements. Ensure that all equipment meets regulatory and quality standards and take corrective actions to address any non-compliance. Collaborate with Quality Assurance, the Responsible Pharmacist, Validation, and Regulatory Affairs to implement and maintain proper documentation, including equipment logs, maintenance records, change controls, deviations/CAPAs, and qualification and validation reports. Support equipment and facility qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ), commissioning, cleanroom classification and requalification (BS EN ISO 14644), and environmental monitoring activities, and maintain the validated state of equipment through the change control process. Respond promptly to equipment breakdowns, emergencies, and production interruptions to minimise downtime and protect patient supply. Work closely with pharmacy and production personnel to coordinate repairs and planned maintenance and minimise disruption to the compounding schedule. Develop and manage the maintenance budget, spare parts strategy, and external contractor and vendor relationships. Identify opportunities for process optimisation, efficiency improvements, and cost savings related to equipment maintenance and operation. Participate in cross-functional teams to implement improvement projects and contribute to a continuous improvement culture within the organisation. Stay up to date with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practice related to pharmaceutical and compounding equipment maintenance. Make sure all assets, parts, and work orders are updated and tracked in the CMMS for all facility equipment. You Have: Right to work in the United Kingdom. Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in a related field, such as engineering. Ability to safely lift and carry items weighing up to 25 kg, either in conjunction with regular responsibilities or those assigned in other areas as directed. Proficiency with business computer systems and applications, specifically Microsoft Word, Excel, and project management tools. Ability to troubleshoot problems with machinery without supervision or direction. Ability to document predictive and preventive maintenance charts, technical data, and other data; interpret data and provide relevant input for process improvement. Ability to communicate effectively with others in spoken and written English. Ability to bend, stoop, reach overhead, and climb ladders; ability to climb stairs up to three flights and work at height using scissor or bucket lifts. Ability to work cooperatively and collaboratively with others. Capacity to receive and apply cross-functional training; willingness to assist other functions and work groups as needed so the department achieves or exceeds its business objectives. Ability to comprehend and adhere to all company policies and procedures, including those related to attendance and scheduling, honesty and integrity, confidentiality, safety, and conflicts of interest. 5+ years of experience in maintenance or engineering within the pharmaceutical industry, or a similar regulated industry (e.g., MHRA, CAA). Working knowledge of GMP requirements (MHRA Rules and Guidance for Pharmaceutical Manufacturers and Distributors, the “Orange Guide”; EU GMP Annex 1 where applicable) and experience maintaining equipment in a GMP environment. Demonstrated high-level ability to troubleshoot, maintain, and operate advanced technical equipment in a related industry. Demonstrated ability to teach and motivate in a highly technical and fast-paced environment. 10+ years of formal leadership experience with direct reports, both hourly and salaried. Knowledge of and experience with PLC systems. Knowledge of and experience with CMMS systems. Ability to present problems and solutions in a formal setting to mid- and senior-level management. Ability to delegate complex tasks and follow up on completion. Experience working with multiple facilities and other facility managers to implement systems and solutions to network-level problems. Ability to assess talent at both the salaried and hourly level to provide performance management and reward based on accomplishments and ability. Ability to evaluate personnel needs and adapt existing resources by structure and shift to enhance the business and support operations. Business acumen, emotional intelligence, and willingness to objectively assess issues (both operations and personnel) and provide solutions. Willingness to participate in an on-call rota and be available for emergency situations. Formal training or certification (e.g., NVQ/City & Guilds, HNC/HND, or equivalent) in at least one of the following areas: electrical, mechanical, plumbing, air compression, PLC systems, or HVAC trades. Preferred Qualifications: 10+ years of experience leading multi-discipline teams. 10+ years of maintenance experience in a pharmaceutical manufacturing or compounding facility (including MHRA-licensed “Specials” or GPhC-registered sterile and non-sterile compounding), or a similar GMP environment with the equipment referenced above. 10+ years of electrical knowledge and electronic principles. Chartered Engineer (CEng) status, or advanced degree or training in engineering, maintenance, or another related field. Advanced formal training in lean or Six Sigma. title: Sr. Clinical Research Associate (Australia)
description: Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development. We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there. If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you! Job Overview The Senior Clinical Research Associate (Sr. CRA) independently performs, coordinates and oversees clinical site monitoring activities, ensuring compliance with study protocols, Alimentiv and sponsor procedures, ICH-GCP guidelines and local regulatory requirements. Serving as a primary liaison between investigative sites, Alimentiv and sponsors, the Sr. CRA plays a key role in the successful execution of clinical studies from site selection and start-up through monitoring and close-out. This role also provides guidance and mentorship to CRA I and CRA II colleagues and may participate in CRA assessment visits, co-monitoring activities, audits and inspections. Key Responsibilities Independently conduct and document onsite and remote site management activities, including site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits, in accordance with applicable SOPs and study requirements. Serve as a primary point of contact for investigative sites, building effective working relationships and ensuring site questions, issues, action items and protocol deviations are followed through to resolution. Review source documentation and study systems to ensure clinical data is accurate, complete and compliant with protocol, regulatory and study requirements; manage and facilitate the resolution of data queries. Oversee site activation and ongoing site management activities, working with sites and cross-functional teams to achieve project timelines, milestones and recruitment objectives. Ensure site personnel are appropriately trained on study protocols, plans, systems, ICH-GCP requirements and project-specific expectations. Routinely review Investigator Site Files (ISF), Trial Master Files (TMF) and study systems for accuracy, completeness, timeliness and compliance. Coordinate site-related study activities and communications, including clinical supplies, investigational product, laboratory materials, ePROs and study documentation. Collaborate with Study Start-up, Regulatory and other cross-functional teams, including supporting document collection and localisation activities where required. Participate in study meetings, Investigator Meetings, audits and inspections, supporting issue resolution and implementation of corrective actions when required. Mentor and support CRA I and CRA II colleagues, including CRA Assessment Visits, co-monitoring and sign-off activities; contribute to CRA interviews, training and process improvement initiatives as requested. Experience & Qualifications (Honours) Bachelor's degree required; a degree in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or Nursing is preferred. A Master's degree is considered an asset. Minimum 4–6 years of relevant clinical research experience; 7–9 years of related experience is preferred. Experience across Phase I–IV clinical trials is preferred. Previous experience in Gastroenterology (GI) clinical trials, particularly Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis, is highly desirable. Thorough knowledge of ICH-GCP and applicable Australian clinical trial regulatory requirements, including TGA guidelines and HREC processes. Previous experience monitoring clinical trials in Australia is highly desirable. Demonstrated experience independently conducting site qualification, initiation, monitoring and close-out visits. Proficiency with clinical trial systems, including EDC platforms (e.g. Medidata Rave, Oracle InForm), IRT, eTMF and CTMS, as well as Microsoft Office. Strong interpersonal, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage priorities with an appropriate sense of urgency. Fluent written and verbal English. Valid driver's licence and ability to travel approximately 40–60%, depending on project assignment and the geographic location of investigative sites. Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition! Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team! Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility. title: Platform Engineer
description: Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer . Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform. Jouw rol Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten. Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting. Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties. Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.   Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau . Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code . Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact. Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden. Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor. Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst. Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. title: Director of Commercial Marketing
description: iFIT ’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey. We're hiring a Director of Commercial Marketing to build and lead marketing for our commercial business, which spans the Freemotion, NordicTrack and iFIT brands. You’ll support several sales motions with very different buyers, from gym chains and large institutions to luxury hotels and independent studio owners. Hospitality is where we have the most to gain and the most to prove, so we're looking for someone who has marketed to hotels and resorts before. The role is fully remote, open anywhere in the US. You'll report into marketing and be marketing's main partner to our commercial sales leaders. You'll own the Freemotion brand and set NordicTrack's commercial go-to-market within its brand standards. You’ll work with a designer embedded from our creative team and with outside agency partners, and you’ll help shape the right mix of in-house and agency support over time. Expect to build a fair amount yourself and to use AI to produce what sales needs. The sales motions you'll support Each of these has its own buyers, sales cycle and proof points. Part of the job is knowing which materials and programs can be shared across motions and which need to be built separately. Win in luxury hospitality: Help our hospitality team win more hotel, resort and spa business by building the credibility and proof we need in a segment where we’re still establishing ourselves. Help sales win more deals: Make sure reps and dealers have current, accurate materials for every customer conversation, and turn new requests around quickly. Make iFIT a reason to buy: Position connected equipment and iFIT content as a differentiator against competitors, and support iFIT subscription sales into gyms, universities, corporations and hospitality. Own Freemotion: Be the Freemotion brand owner, responsible for its positioning, standards and reputation with commercial buyers. Earn NordicTrack credibility in commercial: NordicTrack is best known as a home fitness brand. Build its standing with commercial buyers, leading with Pilates, through proof such as premium installations, case studies and partnerships, within the standards set by the NordicTrack brand team. Build the right support model: Get the most from our in-house and agency resources, and shape the mix over time so sales gets faster, better support. Essential duties and responsibilities Strategy and positioning Define and prioritize segments across fitness facilities (big-box, franchise, university, military, corporate, multifamily), hospitality and wellness (luxury hotels, resorts, spas, residential), and Pilates studio founders. Build segment positioning, messaging and proof points for Freemotion and NordicTrack Commercial, applying NordicTrack brand standards set by the NordicTrack brand team, and partner with the Senior Creative Director on Freemotion's visual identity and commercial creative standards. Track competitors (e.g., Technogym, Life Fitness, Matrix, Precor; Balanced Body and Merrithew in Pilates) and buyer trends, and turn them into guidance sales can use. Own commercial launch planning: timelines, assets, training and success metrics. Sales enablement and partnership Partner with sales leaders across every motion, including domestic, rest-of-world, our VP of Hospitality, and iFIT B2B, on priorities and target accounts. Build a hospitality marketing program in partnership with our VP of Hospitality: flagship properties, case studies, design-trade presence and experiential events. Own the sales toolkit: segment decks, brochures, spec sheets, proposal templates, ROI and total-cost-of-ownership tools, battlecards and rep onboarding materials. Build a proof engine: case studies, testimonials, reference customers and co-marketing around new installations. Run a customer advisory board and referral program with hotel, gym and studio customers. Support distributors and dealers, including localized materials for European markets. Run a simple intake and prioritization process so sales requests are delivered quickly and predictably. Demand and pipeline Partner with the paid media and web teams on website lead capture, conversion and lead generation across every sales motion. Build on the studio founder discovery completed before you join: launch a pilot quickly, then scale the channels that produce qualified leads. Give territory managers simple playbooks for following up on studio leads, and coach them on using them. Brief any paid media to studio prospects within the paid media team's standards, and track leads, cost per lead and conversion. Run account-based campaigns and LinkedIn programs for priority gyms and hotel groups. Work with sales operations to make sure inbound leads are captured, routed and followed up, with clear reporting on lead sources, conversion and pipeline sourced and influenced. Own trade show and commercial event strategy and content, partnering with the events manager on execution. Manage our agency partners, including for social media and trade PR in fitness and hospitality media. Team and operations Lead and develop the team, and make the case for new roles as the business grows. Set up AI tools and workflows for producing sales materials, copy, localized versions and account-specific content, with checks for quality, accuracy and brand. Use AI within iFIT's policies on AI use, data privacy and intellectual property, and train the team to do the same. Build key materials hands-on, and set the embedded designer’s commercial priorities in partnership with the Senior Creative Director. Assess which work is best done in-house and which by agencies, recommend changes, and manage vendors for PR, freelance and production work. Own the commercial marketing budget and report results to marketing and commercial leadership. What success looks like In your first 30 days Sales has a single front door to marketing, with a known turnaround for requests. Decision rights with the NordicTrack brand team and commercial sales are agreed. A hospitality plan is agreed with sales, including a target property list. The most-used hospitality and studio sales materials are refreshed, and a studio pilot is launched based on the discovery completed before you joined. A clear working rhythm with our agency partners is in place, and leads and pipeline influenced have a baseline. In your first 90 days Hospitality: outreach to target properties is live, at least one flagship property is committed with sales, and the first hospitality case study is in production. Pilates studios: the pilot is producing qualified leads for territory managers, and the best-performing channel is being scaled. The core sales toolkit for every segment is current and in a shared library reps use. Commercial leadership has approved a 2027 commercial marketing plan: priority segments and accounts, trade show calendar, budget and measures. You’ve recommended the right mix of in-house and agency support for the year ahead. By the end of your first year Commercial marketing's contribution to pipeline is measured by segment and growing. The studio funnel produces a steady flow of qualified leads at a target cost, scaled up through the channels the pilot proved out. Hospitality pipeline and wins are growing, with flagship properties to point to. Commercial buyers see NordicTrack as a credible choice, backed by flagship installations and case studies. Sales materials are delivered faster and to a higher standard than today, supported by an AI-enabled production system. Education and experience Basic qualifications (measurable, disqualifier) Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or a related field. 8+ years in marketing, including 4+ years in B2B or commercial marketing for physical products (fitness equipment, hospitality supply or similar). Track record partnering with a quota-carrying sales organization, with measurable pipeline or revenue impact. 3+ years marketing to hospitality buyers, such as hotel and resort owners and operators, hotel brands, spas or hospitality design firms, with a track record of helping win business in the segment. Experience supporting more than one sales motion, such as key-account or dealer-led selling alongside relationship-led selling or high-volume lead generation. Working knowledge of digital lead generation (landing pages, nurture, paid media and cost per lead), and experience testing new channels or running customer discovery. Demonstrated use of AI tools in marketing production, with examples of workflows you built and how you ensured quality, accuracy and brand consistency. Hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms. Experience planning trade shows and experiential events. Hands-on ability to build sales materials, write copy, and brief and direct designers and agencies. Experience managing people, agencies and a budget. Willingness to travel up to 20%, including internationally. Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. Preferred qualifications (non-measurable, not a disqualifier) Existing relationships with hotel brands, management companies or hospitality design firms. Experience marketing to gym chains, franchise groups or other fitness facilities. Experience taking a consumer brand upmarket or into commercial and professional channels. Pilates or boutique fitness category experience. Experience at a brand with both consumer and commercial businesses, working alongside consumer brand teams. Experience marketing B2B software or subscriptions. International or multi-region experience, especially Europe. Comfortable in a matrixed organization, with high ownership and clear, concise writing. title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center.
